patch.summary: Accept, reject or withdraw a proposal
patch.description: ACCEPTED and REJECTED are decisions of the client, WITHDRAWN belongs to the specialist, and only a PENDING proposal can be changed. Accepting runs in one transaction: the offer wins, the competing offers are rejected, and the project moves to IN_PROGRESS with the specialist assigned. Only one proposal per project may be accepted.

get.summary: Project progress behind a share link
get.description: Accessible without an account, read-only. A link that does not exist, one that was revoked and one that expired all answer an identical 404, so a visitor cannot probe which tokens once existed. The response carries an `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` header because the token travels in the address.

404.description: Link is invalid, revoked or not found
